title: Optimise your Google Business Profile
blurb: Fill every gap in your Google profile so you show up in more local searches.

steps.title: Open GBP Optimization
steps.body: Click **GBP Optimization**. If asked, connect your Google Business Profile first.

steps.title: Write your description
steps.body: Say what you do, where, and for whom, in plain words. Mention the suburbs or towns you cover.

steps.title: Categories and services
steps.body: Set your main category (like 'Plumber' or 'Physiotherapist') and add the services you actually offer.

steps.title: Add photos
steps.body: Add a profile photo, a cover photo and real photos of your work. Fresh photos help.

steps.title: Hours and contact
steps.body: Check hours, phone and address. Add a text message or WhatsApp option if you use them.

steps.title: Social links
steps.body: Add links to your Facebook, Instagram and other profiles.

steps.title: Save and wait
steps.body: Save. Most changes sync within minutes, but Google can take up to 24 hours to approve them.
